cities.heroSubhead: Boombastic Events have been throwing parties across the Midlands for over a decade. Here's what's coming up in Bedford.
aboutBody: Bedford has been one of our home cities for years. THE 2PM CLUB at Esquires sells out fast, and the crowd we get on a Saturday afternoon is genuinely special.
Whether it's a daytime disco, silent disco or a Footloose 80s night, our Bedford events are built for people who don't fancy a 2am finish.
cities.metaDescription: Upcoming Boombastic Events in Bedford. Daytime disco, silent disco and decades parties at Bedford Esquires.

faq.q: Where are Boombastic Events held in Bedford?
faq.a: Most of our Bedford events are held at Bedford Esquires, a long-standing live music venue in the centre of town.
THE 2PM CLUB is a daytime disco. Four hours of 80s, 90s and 00s anthems from 2pm to 6pm. All the energy of a night out, home by 7-ish.

cities.heroSubhead: Boombastic Events bring daytime disco, silent disco and decades parties to Luton. Here's what's coming up.
aboutBody: Luton is a Boombastic stronghold. The Hat Factory has hosted some of our best afternoons, and the local crowd shows up loud every time.
Daytime disco, silent disco, Footloose 80s, 90s parties - Luton gets the lot. Saturday afternoons that beat any night out.
cities.metaDescription: Upcoming Boombastic Events in Luton. Daytime disco, silent disco and decades parties at The Hat Factory.

faq.q: Where are Boombastic Events held in Luton?
faq.a: Our Luton events are held at The Hat Factory, the town's main cultural venue.

faq.q: What time does THE 2PM CLUB Luton start?
faq.a: Doors open at 2pm and the party runs until 6pm. You'll be home for dinner.

cities.heroSubhead: Coventry's home for daytime disco, silent disco and decades parties. Tickets selling fast.
aboutBody: Coventry has fully embraced the daytime disco. HMV Empire is one of our favourite rooms and the city centre crowd brings it every time.
Four hours of 80s, 90s and 00s floor-fillers, then home for tea. That's the Coventry formula and it works.
cities.metaDescription: Upcoming Boombastic Events in Coventry. Daytime disco and decades parties at HMV Empire.

faq.q: Where are Boombastic Events held in Coventry?
faq.a: Most Coventry events take place at HMV Empire, the city's main live music venue.

faq.q: Is parking easy near HMV Empire?
faq.a: Yes, Coventry city centre car parks are a short walk away. Public transport is also excellent.

cities.heroSubhead: Milton Keynes' home for daytime disco, silent disco and decades parties. Tickets selling fast.
aboutBody: Milton Keynes has been one of our biggest cities for years. MK11 Live and other venues across the city have hosted some of our most memorable afternoons.
If you live in MK and you've never tried a daytime disco, fix that. You'll wonder why you ever bothered with nights out.
cities.metaDescription: Upcoming Boombastic Events in Milton Keynes. Daytime disco and decades parties.

faq.q: Where are Boombastic Events held in Milton Keynes?
faq.a: Our MK events take place across multiple venues including MK11 Live. Check each event listing for the specific venue.

faq.q: What is THE 2PM CLUB Milton Keynes?
faq.a: A daytime disco for grown-ups. Four hours of 80s, 90s and 00s anthems, 2pm to 6pm. Home by 7-ish.

cities.heroSubhead: Northampton is Boombastic's home town. Daytime disco, silent disco, decades parties - all of it, here.
aboutBody: Northampton is where it all started. Twelve years of Boombastic Events, hundreds of nights, tens of thousands of people through the doors.

We have hosted events at The Picturedrome for years. THE 2PM CLUB 80s Edition on Sat 3rd Oct now takes place upstairs at The Charles Bradlaugh, 1 Earl Street, Northampton, NN1 3AU. Existing tickets remain valid. Check each event listing for its venue.
cities.metaDescription: Upcoming Boombastic Events in Northampton. THE 2PM CLUB on 3rd October is at The Charles Bradlaugh. Check each listing for dates, venues and tickets.

faq.q: Where are Boombastic Events held in Northampton?
faq.a: THE 2PM CLUB 80s Edition on Sat 3rd Oct is upstairs at The Charles Bradlaugh, with steps to the event room. Other dates have their own venue details. Always check your event listing.

faq.q: How long has Boombastic been running events in Northampton?
faq.a: Over 12 years. Northampton is our home town and we run more events here than anywhere else.
